title: Nowhere near the best but I have seen worse
text: I have received two boxes from this place already. I was not 100% disappointed but I was nowhere near satisfied. I will wait for the third box to see if it’s any better if not I am going to cancel and look for something worth my money. I will adjust my review after the third box as of right now it is not looking that good. One more sidenote the shirts that I have been sent are way too small for any grown man but my grandson likes them.
label: neutral
